mechanisms.statement: Across 17 source(s), customer evidence suggests: An Indie Hackers founder building an idea validator got zero conversions at €19. Commenters identified that founders can get similar feedback for free from Claude/ChatGPT by typing 'brutally roast my startup,' making €19 a steep ask. One us

Across 9 source(s), market evidence suggests: Lenny's newsletter by Todd Jackson describes founders' validation sequences: market-first, experience-ripe-for-improvement, or problem-first approaches. Example from Mahima and co-founders at a parenting startup shows they started with open

Across 3 source(s), competition evidence suggests: ValidatorAI is used by 300,000+ founders for idea validation. The tool scores and grades ideas, analyzes competition, finds customers, and provides a clear next-step prompt for building a landing page or site. Measures founder momentum befo

Across 3 source(s), general evidence suggests: Crustdata's analysis of Crunchbase alternatives found data quality issues: 15-40% accuracy gap between Crunchbase valuations and actual Series B term sheets. One data platform stopped using Crunchbase because customers kept flagging errors.

Across 5 source(s), product evidence suggests: MOOC research shows sharp initial dropout spikes across all student cohorts. Intended completers have a median lifetime of 35% of the course, versus 10% for browsers and under 1% for non-respondents. After the initial drop, decline rates ar

Across 1 source(s), distribution evidence suggests: Tech startups commonly overspend on PR in early stages, which can quickly deplete capital. Startups may want to use AI tools for marketing materials at lower costs before hiring teams.

business_components.title: Customer definition
business_components.content: First-time and solo founders globally who struggle to validate startup ideas, currently piecing together free resources, AI chatbots, and scattered tools with no clear signal on when they're ready to launch.

business_components.title: Positioning
business_components.content: An AI-powered platform that guides founders through a milestone-based workflow from idea to launch, replacing scattered tools with structured validation.

business_components.title: Value proposition
business_components.content: Replaces fragmented validation workflows with a single guided system that helps founders make evidence-based decisions, complete research and customer discovery faster, and know exactly when they have enough validation to build and launch.

business_components.title: Distribution strategy
business_components.content: Interview 8–12 ICP buyers and map the real budget holder before finalizing packaging.
